g.text: IOM EL NIÑO GLOBAL APPEAL / AUGUST 2026
SOMALIA: USING DATA TO GUIDE PRE
Identify where hazards are most likely
Enable rapid initial support and reduce
indicate priority tier under the IASC ENSO Cell and IOM regional frameworks.
The IASC ENSO Cell identifies countries requiring heightening attention due to projected El Niño impacts and related humanita
n risks, while IOM additionally monitors other contexts where mobility
and displacement risks may warrant preparedness even if they are not formally prioritized by the ENSO Cell.
